asset_reuse_decisions.identity_content: Native gray panel, white device face, round button frames and full leaders already match.

qr_identity.method: 41x41 QR module interior sampling; grayscale threshold150; sampling center +/-22% module pitch avoids small raster dot aliasing; omit central logo only
